projects.title: FinTech Transaction Processing System
projects.summary: A production-style banking/payments backend: accounts, deposits, withdrawals and transfers that stay correct under concurrency, retries and crashes.
highlights: Pessimistic row locks (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) with lock ordering by account id to prevent double spending and deadlocks.
Idempotency keys: Redis fast path plus a PostgreSQL UNIQUE constraint as the final guarantee, so retries never move money twice.
Ledger table with one immutable DEBIT/CREDIT entry per balance change; integration tests check that the ledger always matches balances.
Kafka events consumed independently by a risk engine, notification service and audit log, with retries and dead-letter topics; every consumer is idempotent.
Concurrency test: 10 parallel withdrawals of 100 from a balance of 500 give exactly 5 successes and a final balance of 0.
JWT access tokens + single-use rotating refresh tokens, Redis rate limiting, Prometheus metrics and a Grafana dashboard.
limitations: Kafka events are published after the DB commit; the production fix is the Transactional Outbox pattern.
No currency exchange; deposits are simulated; the risk engine is rule-based and only raises alerts.
